entry_state: A conditional offset preserves the annual rows only under the stated economic, tax and reporting assignments; no full Apple history is established. Different underlying liabilities still give different category and dated settlement paths. The next section separates lease use, liability and tax state, with the base two-payment schedule and a same-asset modification introduced; tax consequences continue next.
exit_state: The lease case reconciles gross deferred tax, tax-payment timing and elected cash classification under explicit fictional law. Apple's reported tax expense, payable and deferred balances leave diagnostic residuals rather than identified transactions. The State Aid discussion separates charge, restricted assets and later payment, with conditional precision checks. The unrecognized-tax-benefit roll-forward now introduces a further population whose interpretation continues next.
findings: The lease example retains gross DTA/DTL and actual tax-payment timing; its two-year statements and cash bridges agree under the declared assumptions.
Apple's current-payable residual 4901 and net-deferred residual -1080 are defined diagnostically, without assigning them to invented journal entries.

The State Aid charge and settlement figures have different dates, currency and precision. The conditional dollar movement residual excludes zero, but the text does not assert a particular foreign-exchange entry.
Restricted securities are not all ready cash, and the settlement entry expressly assumes conversion has already happened. No new confirmed defect.
